ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_FinancialProductApplication_DEP] AS
BEGIN
WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication AS
(
	SELECT
		BDG.SCHM_CODE AS FinancialProductId
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.SCHM_TYPE AS FcbsApplicationId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE BDG
	where BDG.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialProductId) ,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId) ,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,FcbsApplicationId)
			)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,Timestamp
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication 
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.FinancialProductId) ,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.FinancialInstitutionId) ,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.FcbsApplicationId)
			)) AS HASHROW
		,A.FinancialProductId ,A.FinancialInstitutionId ,A.Timestamp
	FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
		ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
	WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA AS
(
		SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialProductId,TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,ISNULL(SRC.Timestamp,TGT.Timestamp) AS Timestamp
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_TGT TGT
		ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
		AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA;

INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProductApplication
	(FinancialProductId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp
	,FcbsApplicationId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	SRC.FinancialProductId
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.Timestamp
	,SRC.FcbsApplicationId
	,SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,SRC.TaskRunId
	,SRC.WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT')

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA;

END

GO
